summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories and developer-facing inference APIs that let teams discover, host, and run open-weight models without managing infrastructure. Hugging Face remains the central hub, surpassing 3 million public models by August 2026, while China-based model developers have overtaken the U.S. in monthly downloads. Downloads are heavily concentrated, with roughly the top 200 models accounting for nearly half of all platform downloads, and a wave of inference-focused platforms (Together, Fireworks, SiliconFlow, Replicate) compete on speed, price, and model breadth for serving these open models.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The largest open repository and collaboration hub for models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), with hosted Inference Endpoints and serverless inference for running open-weight models.
platforms.pricing: Free public hosting and community tier; Pro at ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and dedicated compute billed per hour by hardware; Enterprise Hub from ~$20/user/mo
features: Model, dataset, and Spaces hosting with Git-based versioning
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Community features: discussions, model cards, leaderboards
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and open-source developers who want to discover, share, fine-tune, and deploy models across the broadest catalog.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first runtime that makes it easy to download and run open LLMs on your own machine via a simple CLI and local REST API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (plus any GGUF model importable)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no usage fees (you supply the hardware); optional Ollama cloud/turbo tier for larger hosted models
features: One-command local model download and execution
GGUF-based quantized models optimized for consumer hardware
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping, offline use, or edge deployment.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and sharing open models via API, with easy deployment of custom models packaged using Cog.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models across text, image, audio, and video
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute (per-second GPU/CPU time); pricing varies by hardware type
features: Run any public model with a single API call
Cog packaging for custom model deployment
Strong support for image/video/audio generative models
platforms.best_for: App developers and startups wanting quick API access to generative models, especially image/video, without managing GPUs.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source LLMs, offering fast serverless APIs and dedicated GPU endpoints.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference (per million input/output tokens); dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters billed hourly; fine-tuning priced separately
features: Broad support for latest open models including DeepSeek and Qwen
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies building production apps on open LLMs who need scalable, cost-efficient inference and fine-tuning.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-optimized inference platform for open and fine-tuned models, emphasizing low latency and high throughput for production workloads.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom/fine-tuned model hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing (per million tokens, varies by model size); on-demand GPU deployments billed per hour
features: LoRA fine-tuning and custom model deployment
platforms.best_for: Teams needing the lowest-latency, high-scale serving of open LLMs in latency-sensitive production applications.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference platform (strong in the China/Asia market) offering fast, affordable serverless APIs for a wide range of open models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, and FLUX
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing with competitive low rates; free credits for popular models; dedicated deployments available
features: Strong catalog of Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and embedding models
platforms.best_for: Developers, especially in Asia, who want low-cost access to leading Chinese open models via a unified API.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform built on custom LPU hardware for extremely fast token generation on open models.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of open models (Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, Gemma, and others)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; free developer tier; enterprise/on-prem options
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time, latency-critical applications (voice, agents, chat) on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway/aggregator that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pass-through pay-per-token pricing with a small markup; no subscription; credit-based
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Price and latency comparison across providers
Access to both open and frontier closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access and automatic routing across many open model backends.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: A serverless cloud platform for running custom AI/ML code and model inference with on-demand GPUs, defined entirely in Python.
platforms.model_count: Unlimited (bring-your-own / any open model you deploy)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second compute billing for CPU/GPU usage; generous free tier credits
features: On-demand GPU scaling with fast cold starts
Batch jobs, cron, and web endpoints
platforms.best_for: ML engineers who want to deploy custom open models and pipelines as scalable serverless APIs without managing infrastructure.
